help:
usage: comic-sol [-h] [--version] [--json]
                 {doctor,init,status,validate,bind-plan,resume,finalize,dogfood,handoff,mcp,skill-install,skill-uninstall,setup,repair,uninstall} ...

positional arguments:

  --version             show program's version number and exit
  --json

init.help:
usage: comic-sol init [-h] [--interactive] [--output-root OUTPUT_ROOT]
                      [--title TITLE] [--source SOURCE]
                      [--request-json REQUEST_JSON]
                      [--starter {minimal-one-page,dialogue-two-page,action-focused}]
                      [--page-count {1,2,3,4}]
                      [--image-capability-status {available,unavailable}]
                      [--image-capability-name IMAGE_CAPABILITY_NAME]
                      [--supports-reference-images] [--supports-dimensions]

Create a project from explicit flags or a guided terminal session.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --interactive         prompt for project settings (human terminals only)
  --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT
                        parent directory for the project
  --title TITLE         project title
  --source SOURCE       UTF-8 .txt or .md story source
  --request-json REQUEST_JSON
                        optional request settings JSON
  --starter {minimal-one-page,dialogue-two-page,action-focused}
                        initialize from a bundled v1 storyboard starter
  --page-count {1,2,3,4}
                        planned page count (default: 2)
  --image-capability-status {available,unavailable}
  --image-capability-name IMAGE_CAPABILITY_NAME
  --supports-reference-images
  --supports-dimensions
